g.text: Finite trials; not converged. Latest completed batch from each saved input.
Common color scale: −0.5 to +0.5 physical Sz. Raw coordinate profiles; no translations.
Dashed line: uniform 1/9 reference = 0.5 per column. N54 adjacent sectors are not measured.
